children: Stellantis named Arnaud Belloni as the new chief executive of its Fiat, Abarth and Lancia brands in addition and chief marketing officer for Europe, replacing Olivier Francois.
Belloni rejoins Stellantis from Renault, the French automaker he worked with from 2020 as global chief marketing officer and then as chief branding officer.

Before leaving for Renault, Belloni spent 16 years leading marketing strategy for Stellantis's Italian and French brands, including Fiat and Lancia marketing director, managing director of Lancia France, and vice president of marketing for Asia Pacific. Between 2015 and 2020 he served as the Citroen brand's global chief marketing officer for communications and sports.
Olivier Francois will support Belloni through mid-October to ensure a smooth transition and will continue to support Stellantis as a company strategic advisor, the company said.
